Author: Havyrl
Name: FFXIV Discord Bridge
Punchline: Bridges FFXIV chat with Discord via webhooks and slash commands.
Description:
Forwards FFXIV chat channels to Discord via webhooks and allows sending messages back from Discord using slash commands.

Bugs & suggestions: https://github.com/havyrl/FFXIVDiscordChatBridge/issues
Changelog:
### Bug Fixes
- Wrap repo.json in array (Dalamud custom repo format)

### Features
- Item links and map links forwarding via MessageConverter
- Delete original Discord message after back-channel forwarding
- Generate map pin image and attach to Discord message
- Localize chat type names and add /chattypes command
- Add MapLinkStyle config toggle (TextWithLink / ImageWithPin)
